cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've stood still like you. Shadow control. Yours moved before you did; what changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped because I can't find the exit. I was thinking of leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exit first, yes. Think about that bench without moving. Does your shadow turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it follows your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.
